jobs.description: Working as a Data Analyst focused on Business Intelligence, Reporting Automation, Process Automation, and Customer Experience Analytics. Responsible for developing scalable reporting solutions, workflow automation systems, interactive dashboards, and operational analytics to improve business efficiency and decision-making across multiple live projects.
responsibilities: Develop interactive Power BI dashboards and business reports for management and stakeholders.
Design and automate workflow solutions using Google Apps Script, Google Sheets, and Google Workspace.
Build and maintain Flow Management Systems (FMS) for multiple customer experience and market research projects.
Develop Productivity Management Systems (PMS) to monitor employee productivity, project performance, and reward & recognition tracking.
Automate recurring reports, approval workflows, and email communication to improve operational efficiency.
Create dynamic MIS reports and executive dashboards using Power BI, Advanced Excel, and Google Sheets.
Develop scalable Google Forms and Google Sheets-based data collection platforms for live business operations.
Write SQL queries for data extraction, transformation, validation, and business reporting.
Perform data cleaning, validation, analysis, and visualization to support business decision-making.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to improve reporting processes, automate manual operations, and optimize business workflows.
achievements: Developed automated email workflow solutions that significantly reduced repetitive manual communication and improved operational efficiency.
Built Google Apps Script-based automation systems that streamlined data collection and workflow management across multiple live projects.
Designed and implemented internal Flow Management Systems (FMS) and Productivity Management Systems (PMS) to improve operational visibility and process standardization.
Created real-time dashboards and automated MIS reporting systems enabling faster, data-driven decision-making.
Reduced manual reporting effort through workflow automation, reusable reporting templates, and centralized data management.
Supported customer experience and market research projects by delivering reliable analytics, reporting solutions, and business insights.
